change: Bootloader fixed startup scatter records are now read-only C descriptors with direct adapter calls; the superseded self-relative assembly table was removed.

dispatch_comparison.method: Unicorn ran the old and new linked dispatch functions. Adapter entry hooks captured descriptor words and returned the next record pointer; adapter bodies were not emulated.

full_memory_emulation_attempt.reason: Unicorn 2.1.4 rejects the Cortex-M55 low-overhead LE instruction at old ELF PC 0x422aea in opencfw_boot_zero_table; no memory-equality claim was made.

limits: The adapter call comparison does not validate the downstream memory initialization or physical boot. The bootloader still contains architecture-specific assembly.

renode_boot_comparison.qualification: Both ran through the reconstructed bootloader into the same application with lenient Renode peripheral fixtures. This does not prove physical-device boot.
